safe.label: I built my whole life around one person
safe.note: I saw my reflection in the snow-covered hills — the mirror is him, not me.

safe.label: I would give up this love if it is holding me still
safe.note: Take my love, take it down. Offered as generosity, phrased as surrender.

safe.label: Even the children get older, and so do I
safe.note: Aging admitted sideways, by pointing at someone else first.

safe.label: Time keeps moving and I am not sure I can keep up
safe.note: The seasons-of-my-life question. Stated as weather, felt as body and nerve.

safe.label: I climbed a mountain and turned around before the top
safe.note: The retreat is narrated as wisdom. It was a decision made while scared.

real.label: I am twenty-seven with no degree and one record nobody bought
real.note: The mountain is not a metaphor this week. It is whether to enroll in school by fall or give it one more year.
